reading.title: Reading

in_person.evidence: Closed by a teacher who heard it.

verification.teacher_verified: A teacher heard this and confirmed it

ladder.awaitingTeacher: Waiting for your teacher to hear this

missing.accuracy: More of the answers need to be right.
missing.previous_rung: The rung below is still open.
missing.sessions: It needs to hold across more sittings.
missing.teacher_verdict_required: Your teacher has to hear this one.

reason.complete_teacher_verified: All three rungs, the last heard by a teacher.

intro.heading: Meet this letter
intro.noNarration: No narration is recorded for this lesson.
intro.voiceNote: The explanation is read by a synthesized voice. Recitation is never synthesized — only a person recites.
intro.animationOff: Motion is reduced, so this is shown still.

provenance.studio_synth_reviewed: Studio audio, reviewed by a person

notYetRecorded.title: Not yet recorded
notYetRecorded.body: No one has recorded this letter for you yet, and no machine voice will stand in for a reciter. Ask your teacher to record it.

practice.heading: Practice
practice.selfConfirmNote: You are confirming your own reading. It is recorded as your word, not as a teacher's.
practice.teacherNote: Your teacher closes this rung. What you record here is your own reading, kept beside it.
practice.noPenalties: No timer, no hearts, nothing lost for a wrong answer.
practice.offline: That did not reach the server. Try again when you are back online.

done.title: That is the sitting
done.body: Everything you did was recorded as evidence.

empty.title: Nothing to practise here right now
empty.body: The planner found nothing due and nothing new that fits.

review.title: Review
review.body: Concepts that have come round again, scheduled by the same engine as ḥifẓ.

none.title: Nothing is due for review
none.body: Reading concepts come round on their own schedule. Nothing has yet.

letters.title: Every letter, by makhraj
letters.body: The alphabet arranged by where in the mouth each letter is made, from the deepest throat to the two lips.
letters.noLetters: No letter belongs to this place on its own.

makhraj.jawf: The empty space of the mouth and throat

halq.aqsa: The deepest part of the throat
halq.adna: The nearest part of the throat

lisan.aqsa_lahat: The back of the tongue, at the soft palate
lisan.aqsa_hanak: The back of the tongue, at the hard palate
lisan.haffah_adras: The edge of the tongue, at the molars
lisan.adna_haffah: The nearest edge of the tongue
lisan.taraf_noon: The tip of the tongue, above the front teeth
lisan.taraf_ra: The tip of the tongue, at the gum
lisan.nita: The tip of the tongue, at the gum ridge
lisan.safir: The tip of the tongue, between the front teeth
lisan.lithah: The tip of the tongue, at the gums

shafatan.batn_shafah: The inside of the lower lip, at the front teeth

correction.heading: What to notice
correction.notice_the_dots: These two share a shape and differ only in their dots. Look at the dots.
correction.notice_the_shape: Look again at the shape of the letter.
correction.notice_the_makhraj: These two are made close together in the mouth. Listen for where.
correction.notice_the_vowel: The letter is right; the vowel on it is not.
correction.known_pair: These two are often taken for each other.
correction.production_needs_work: Listen once more for where it is made, then try it again.

reason.emphatic_counterpart: one is the emphatic of the other
reason.interdental_and_sibilant: one is interdental, the other a whistling letter
reason.neighbouring_makhraj: their places of articulation are neighbours
reason.same_letter_different_vowel: the same letter carrying a different vowel
reason.same_makhraj: they share a place of articulation
reason.same_skeleton_dots_moved: the same shape, the dots moved
reason.throat_depth: they sit at different depths of the throat

reason.production_not_yet_observed: Nobody heard this one, so nothing was recorded.
reason.response_does_not_match_activity: That answer did not belong to this item.
